what_happened: Plan-time Lean runs settled the plan's central design question instead of leaving it to implementation: lean_run_code compiled (a) the free-register anchor clause from the six facts the landed common-shift proof already assembles plus exactly two bounds on the target register, (b) the non-removability of the lower bound with an explicit arithmetic witness, and (c) both pinned kappa-collision witness pairs by decide. That measurement is what split branch 3 into a dispatchable monotone half and an explicitly excluded antitone half, rather than defaulting to a blanket exclusion.
